scripts.pretest:flow: node -e "if (+process.versions.node.split('.')[0] < 20) { console.error('These tests need Node 20 or newer (this is ' + process.version + '). Run: nvm use'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.pretest:targets: node -e "if (+process.versions.node.split('.')[0] < 20) { console.error('These tests need Node 20 or newer (this is ' + process.version + '). Run: nvm use'); process.exit(1); }"
